## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      18 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 20.04.2026 - 01.10.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _emilie_hys_, 01.10.2026, 1/5: "Ça marchais vraiment bien mais maintenant toute l’application bug, je pouvais facilement changer les couleurs de ‘écriture en appuyant sur les points au bord de la ligne/du paragraphe mais ça ne marche plus. de plus dès que je tente d’écrire une lettre cela remonte mon texte ce qui fait que je ne peux pas voir ce que j’écris..; C’est dommage c’était super avant ca"
            2. _K.loves20_, 27.09.2026, 1/5: "So far notion has been great, my number 1 go to for note taking among other things. But now the app has been more of nuisance than anything because it has several glitches now. For one, whenever I highlight a paragraph and try applying italic, or bold to it, it only applies to the first word and only allows me to edit that first word. Another recent development being that whenever I try highlighting a text to put it in a different color, by the time I go to the color menu the entire thing becomes deselected and uncolorable. Please fix this."
            3. _BlA387532_, 24.09.2026, 1/5: "The amount of times it glitches is absolutely uncanny. And that for 700€+ per year. Currently looking for an alternative."
<!--/ir-theme-->
